Supply Voltage -> Voltage Difference.full: Kirchhoff, G. (1845). Ueber den Durchgang eines elektrischen Stromes durch eine Ebene. Annalen der Physik, 140(4), 497-514. Kirchhoff's Voltage Law.
Nilsson, J.W. & Riedel, S.A. (2015). Electric Circuits. 10th Edition. Pearson. Chapter 7: RC Circuits.

Capacitor Voltage -> Voltage Difference.full: Kirchhoff, G. (1845). Kirchhoff's Voltage Law - sum of voltages around a closed loop equals zero.

Voltage Difference -> Current.full: Ohm, G.S. (1827). Die galvanische Kette, mathematisch bearbeitet. Original statement of Ohm's Law: V = IR.
Halliday, D., Resnick, R. & Walker, J. (2013). Fundamentals of Physics. 10th Edition. Wiley. Chapter 26: Current and Resistance.

Resistance -> Current.full: Ohm, G.S. (1827). Die galvanische Kette, mathematisch bearbeitet. I = V/R shows inverse relationship.

Current -> Charging Rate.full: Faraday, M. (1834). Experimental Researches in Electricity. Definition of current as rate of charge flow: I = dQ/dt.

Charging Rate -> Capacitor Charge.full: Sterman, J.D. (2000). Business Dynamics. McGraw-Hill. Stock-flow dynamics: stocks accumulate flows.

Capacitor Charge -> Capacitor Voltage.full: Faraday, M. (1837). Experimental Researches in Electricity. Capacitor equation: Q = CV, thus V = Q/C.
Serway, R.A. & Jewett, J.W. (2018). Physics for Scientists and Engineers. 10th Edition. Cengage. Chapter 26: Capacitance.
